steel scrap.Environmental Impact: Recycling reduces energy consumption, keeps materials out of oceans, and saves virgin resources.
steel scrap.Recycling Process: Materials are transported to Material Recovery Facilities (MRFs) for sorting, then shredded, melted, or pulped into new materials.
steel scrap.Common Mistakes: Wish-cycling: throwing unrecyclable soft plastics or mixed materials into the bin hoping they get recycled.

smartphone.Disposal Warnings: Contains toxic chemicals, heavy metals, or flammable components. Do not puncture or crush.
smartphone.Environmental Impact: Improper disposal leaches highly toxic substances (like lead, mercury, lithium) into soil and groundwater.
smartphone.Recycling Process: Handled by specialized facilities where toxic components are neutralized or safely extracted, and rare metals are recovered.
smartphone.Common Mistakes: Throwing batteries, bulbs, or electronics in regular trash bins leading to toxic contamination.
